2608.19163.title: Interpretable AI predicts a 2026 summer dry anomaly in central China
2608.19163.paper_summary: Seasonal precipitation anomalies are largely regulated by atmospheric circulation, which dynamical models predict with greater reliability than precipitation itself. Here, we employ a deep learning model that translates dynamical circulation predictions into precipitation estimates. Predictions initialized from March to May consistently indicate a dry anomaly over central China in summer 2026. Retrospective evaluations revealed higher predictive skill in the analogue years, which also tended to feature central equatorial Pacific warming persisting from the preceding winter into summer. This warming favors an anomalous cyclonic circulation over the western North Pacific-South China Sea-South China region, which induces northerly winds and moisture divergence that jointly suppress rainfall over central China. Supporting this mechanism, layer-wise relevance propagation (LRP) independently identifies these northerly winds as the dominant driver of the prediction among all model inputs. Perturbation tests supported this attribution: removing LRP-identified features effectively eliminates the dry anomaly. Our framework thus provides physically interpretable explanations for AI-derived regional climate projections, facilitating evidence-based assessment before observational data become available.
2608.19163.paper_summary_zh: 季節性降水異常主要受到大氣環流的調控，動力學模型對其預測的可靠性高於對降水本身的預測。在此，我們使用一種深度學習模型，將動力學環流預測轉換為降水估算。從三月到五月初始化的預測一致顯示，2026年夏季中國中部地區存在乾燥異常。回顧評估顯示，在類似年份中預測技能更高，這些年份也往往出現赤道中部太平洋的暖化，並持續從前一個冬季延續到夏季。這種暖化有利於在西北太平洋-南海-中國南部地區形成異常的氣旋環流，這會引發北風和水汽輻散，進而共同抑制中國中部的降雨。支持這一機制的層次相關性傳播（LRP）獨立識別出這些北風是所有模型輸入中預測的主要驅動因素。擾動測試支持了這一歸因：去除LRP識別的特徵有效地消除了乾燥異常。因此，我們的框架為AI衍生的區域氣候預測提供了物理上可解釋的解釋，促進了在觀測數據可用之前的基於證據的評估。
